name: Dapur Bu Sri
tagline: Home-cooked rice boxes for meetings, arisan and family events.
about: A home kitchen run by one family since 2014. Every box is cooked the morning it is delivered.
payment: Cash or bank transfer when the order arrives.

items.name: Nasi Box Ayam Bakar
items.description: Rice, grilled chicken thigh, tempe, sambal and fresh vegetables.

items.name: Nasi Box Rendang
items.description: Rice, beef rendang, potato balado, cassava leaves and sambal hijau.

items.name: Nasi Box Sayur Lodeh
items.description: Rice, vegetable lodeh, tofu, tempe and crackers. No meat or fish.

items.name: Tumpeng Mini
items.description: Yellow rice cone for 1 person with six side dishes.

items.name: Prasmanan Package
items.description: Buffet for 50 people: rice, 3 mains, soup, crackers and fruit. Includes serving dishes.

policies: You can change or cancel an order free of charge up to 12 hours before the delivery time by contacting the kitchen.
Deliveries go to the districts listed only.
Each box comes with a spoon and a napkin. Drinks are not included.
